log.hypothesis: Exact channel-2 zeroing masks photons/NH with pt<0.8&E<1.8 as padding; residual error comes from kNN contamination and from saturated channel 2 on kept neutrals.

Original activations: channel-2 residual values after block0/1 for neutral vs charged tokens are moderate (|x2|<15), so a saturated -w read is far from typical and a block-0 restoration unit can detect saturation with margin.

Block-1/2 MLPs also contain dead hidden units usable as exact restoration detectors; channel-2 residual grows with depth so the embedding-level part lost by restoration is a minority of x2 late in the body.

Exact mask plus per-block linear surrogates for every read of channel 2 makes the saturated channel 2 of kept neutrals harmless; remaining damage comes from surrogate error (R2 0.7-0.99), so clean e should drop from 0.079 to ~0.025.

Instead of surrogates, set norm1/norm2 weight[2]=0 in all 28 blocks so channel 2 is never read (1 DoF each); loses channel-2 information for all tokens, so clean damage larger than the surrogate (0.010) but far below saturation (0.079).

Surrogate only on the 6 sublayers with the largest channel-2 information loss (block 5-9 MLPs, block 6 attention), zero norm weight elsewhere; should recover most of the gap between zero-all (0.028) and surrogate-all (0.010).
Surrogate on the top-14 sublayers by information-loss proxy, zero norm weight elsewhere.
Replace the classifier K/V surrogate (8190 DoF) by shrinking body.norm.weight[2] by 1e-4 (1 DoF): the classifier and generator then read ~0 instead of saturated channel 2; masks stay nonzero.
Top-3 surrogates (block 6-8 MLPs) plus zero norm weights elsewhere plus body.norm shrink; smaller edit, more channel-2 information lost.

Exact mask plus exact restoration of channel 2 for kept neutrals (block0 -H, block1 -(H-128)) and gated-linear re-insertion of the regressed channel-2 content in block 2; blocks 3-27 and the heads then see near-original channel 2. Damage limited to blocks 0-2 and xor-photons (13% of neutrals) whose content is lost.
Same as rest_lin but block 2 restores channel 2 of kept neutrals to a constant (neutral mean) instead of the regressed per-token value; ~30 DoF, more clean damage.
Diagnose rest_lin: after block 2 the channel-2 of no-gate neutrals should match the original within ~0.3, and the largest residual deviations should sit on xor photons and gated charged tokens.

Scaling norm2.weight[2] by 2^-10 in blocks 0-2 (detectors rescaled) stops the other MLP units from reading the saturated channel 2, removing the corruption of other channels and of the block-2 channel-2 writes; clean e should drop from 0.026 toward 0.015.
Edited-model activations to refit the block-2 restoration regression on edited features; expect no-gate neutral channel-2 error at block 2 below 0.8.

The remaining clean damage of the restoration edit comes from zeroing channel 2 in the attention of blocks 0-2 (summary tokens already 0.9% off at block 1); rank-1 surrogates there should bring clean e from 0.026 to ~0.014.

Fixing the fp32 accumulation error of the gated-linear units (gate scale 25856->8192, 128-term sparse regression refit on edited features) should cut the restored channel-2 error of no-gate neutrals from 0.85 to ~0.3, lowering clean e from 0.026 to ~0.018.

Xor photons (one kinematic gate) now get marker -128 at block 0, flipped to +128 in block 1 by an exact unit gated on saturated-negative channel 2 AND a neutral/charged discriminant; block 2 then restores their channel-2 content as for the other neutrals. Clean e should drop from 0.0157 to ~0.012.
After the xor fix, channel-2 errors after block 2 should be ~0.3 for all neutrals; remaining deviations should concentrate on gated charged tokens (saturated channel 2).
rest_xor plus rank-1 channel-2 surrogates in the attention of blocks 0-2 (instead of zeroing the read) removes the 0.9% summary-token deviation at block 2; clean e 0.0123 -> ~0.009.
As rx_as plus rank-1 surrogates for the channel-2 read of the block 0-2 MLPs (detector rows excluded).
Original block-1 residual on 1020 new jets as regression targets for the block-2 channel-2 restoration.
Edited-model block-2 features on the same 1020 jets; refitting with 4x more tokens should lower the restoration rmse from 0.26 to ~0.2.

Block-2 restoration refit on 20k edited-model neutral tokens (dense ridge, test rmse 0.057 vs 0.33 before), constant -128 moved to an exact saturating unit, gate scale 4096 to cut fp32 accumulation error; restored channel-2 error ~0.08 should lower clean e from 0.0123 to ~0.008.
Original block-1 residual on 1500 probe-type jets (split2, soft3e-3, P_reco, D, J) as extra restoration targets, so the block-2 regression also covers collinear splits and rescaled jets.
Edited-model block-2 features on the same probe-type jets; current regression error on split2 neutrals is expected to be above the clean 0.06.

Mid: exact mask + exact channel-2 restoration (blocks 0-1, xor flip unit with original row kept) + paired gated-linear re-insertion in block 2 with the regression refit on clean+probe-type jets; split2 error should fall from 0.0155 to ~clean level.
Small: as mid but a single gated-linear unit (no odd-symmetric pair); restoration error ~0.28 instead of 0.05, so clean e rises to ~0.009.
Large: mid plus rank-1 channel-2 surrogates in the attention and MLP of blocks 0-2 instead of zeroing/down-scaling those reads.
Original logits on 1500 held-out clean jets (indices 600-749 per class) as reference for an out-of-sample check.
Mid edit on held-out clean jets: restoration regression was fit on other jets, so clean e should stay ~0.004 and accuracy drop <0.003.
Small edit on held-out clean jets: clean e ~0.014.
Mid edit on held-out soft1e-4 jets: every injected photon is masked exactly, so e vs original-on-clean should equal the clean floor ~0.0045.

Mid with tighter detector/constant-unit gates (no misfires on charged tokens with large channel 2) and gate scale 2048 with K=3.5 for lower fp32 accumulation error; expect equal or slightly better than rx4_mid (0.074).
Small single gated unit at the GELU*tanh inflection region (K=1.2) with gate 2048: restoration error 0.13 instead of 0.28, so clean e should drop from 0.0137 to ~0.008.

Paired gated units keep their (near-dead) original fc1 rows and add only 512 fitted weights each (fit on 50k tokens, in-sample rmse 0.04), so the restoration matches the dense version at about half the DoF.
Single gated unit with 256 added weights on its original row (restoration error ~0.15), ~380 DoF; clean e ~0.008.
Held-out clean check of the 362-DoF edit: clean e ~0.01 and worst per-class accuracy drop well inside 0.02.
Held-out clean check of the 1134-DoF edit: clean e ~0.004.
